critical_finding: exception_fraction alone (AUROC=0.593) outperforms full SBG model (AUROC=0.550), delta=-0.043
exception_dominance_hypothesis_rationale: Exception behavior IS genuine behavioral signal but SBG fusion architecture compresses it away. Volume features (coverage 0.20, call_freq 0.25) compete with exception (0.10) and dilute its signal.

volume_proxy_features.name: coverage_size
volume_proxy_features.rationale: Counts unique lines executed — increases with dead code, refactoring

volume_proxy_features.name: call_freq
volume_proxy_features.rationale: L1 distance on normalized call histogram — dominated by call count

volume_proxy_features.name: call_depth_mean
volume_proxy_features.rationale: Mean call depth — changes with wrapping functions

volume_proxy_features.name: exception_rate
volume_proxy_features.rationale: Fraction of traces with exceptions — genuine behavioral signal

volume_proxy_features.name: call_bigrams
volume_proxy_features.rationale: Call transition sequences — order-sensitive, less volume-correlated

ablation_evidence.interpretation: Coverage HURTS model performance when removed, but only_exception HELPS by +0.043. Coverage and exception are anti-correlated in terms of label signal.

exception_debiased_design.description: Build separate Exception View (exception_fraction + exception_types) and Structural View (call_bigrams + coverage_consistency), ensemble both
exception_debiased_design.rationale: If views are orthogonal, ensemble should beat either alone. If not, exception_fraction alone is sufficient.
exception_debiased_design.fallback: If multi-view provides no improvement, adopt exception_fraction as primary predictor (AUROC=0.593 at 100x lower cost)

residualized_sbg_validity: CONDITIONALLY_VALID — exceptions may be mediators (CHANGED→exceptions→lower coverage), so regressing out exceptions could remove causal path. Use with caution.

evidence.finding: no_coverage AUROC=0.560, delta=+0.010: removing coverage IMPROVES model
9/9 silent bugs (invisible to exception+volume) detected by behavioral oracle
